mapper.insert: insert into batch.workflow_terminal_notification_receipt (tenant_id,event_key,payload_json) values (#{tenantId},#{eventKey},#{payload}::jsonb) on conflict (tenant_id,event_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select payload_json::text from batch.workflow_terminal_notification_receipt where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and event_key=#{eventKey}
mapper.insert: insert into batch.webhook_delivery_log (tenant_id,subscription_id,terminal_event_key,event_type,payload_json,delivery_status,attempt,next_retry_at) values (#{tenantId},#{recipientId},#{eventKey},#{eventType},#{payload}::jsonb,'PENDING',0,current_timestamp) on conflict (tenant_id,subscription_id,terminal_event_key) where terminal_event_key is not null do nothing

insert into batch.notification_delivery_log (tenant_id,rule_id,channel_code,terminal_event_key,event_type,payload_json,delivery_status,attempt,next_retry_at) values (#{tenantId},#{recipientId},#{channelCode},#{eventKey},#{eventType},#{payload}::jsonb,'PENDING',0,current_timestamp) on conflict (tenant_id,rule_id,terminal_event_key) where terminal_event_key is not null do nothing
mapper.select: select source,id,tenant_id,recipient_id,channel_code,event_key,payload_json,attempt from ( select 'WEBHOOK' as source,id,tenant_id,subscription_id as recipient_id, null::text as channel_code,terminal_event_key as event_key,payload_json::text, attempt,next_retry_at from batch.webhook_delivery_log where terminal_event_key is not null and next_retry_at <= #{now} and delivery_status in ('PENDING','EXHAUSTED') and (delivery_claim_until is null or delivery_claim_until <= #{now}) union all select 'RULE' as source,id,tenant_id,rule_id as recipient_id,channel_code, terminal_event_key as event_key,payload_json::text,attempt,next_retry_at from batch.notification_delivery_log where terminal_event_key is not null and next_retry_at <= #{now} and delivery_status in ('PENDING','EXHAUSTED') and (delivery_claim_until is null or delivery_claim_until <= #{now}) ) candidates order by next_retry_at,id,source limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update set delivery_status=#{status},next_retry_at=#{nextRetry,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, delivery_claim_token=null,delivery_claim_until=null, response_body error_message = #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and id=#{row.id} and terminal_event_key=#{row.eventKey} and delivery_claim_token=#{token}::uuid
